title: Canonical scalar tensor unit and associators
statement:
For normalized scalar-extension models over sheaves of rings, restriction along a composite is canonically successive restriction, by identity maps on sections. The ordinary left-adjoint uniqueness comparisons give tensor units and associators, with formulas c⊗x↦c·x and c⊗(d⊗x)↦cφ(d)⊗x. Their derived uniqueness comparisons are compatible with every universal cochain comparison, and hence with the flat-term K-flat models in the main theory.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
theorem systemScalarModelDerivedComposition_rep {R S T : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}}
    {φ : R ⟶ S} {ψ : S ⟶ T} {γ : R ⟶ T} (hγ : γ = φ ≫ ψ)
    (A : SystemScalarModel φ) (B : SystemScalarModel ψ) (D : SystemScalarModel γ)
    (P : CochainComplex
      (ringedSiteModules.{w} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R)) ℤ) :
    (systemScalarModelDerivedComposition hγ A B D).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        D.model.ε.app P =
      B.model.T.map (A.model.ε.app P) ≫
        B.model.ε.app ((A.model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (systemScalarModelComposition hγ A B D)
            (.up ℤ)).hom.app P)
```

proof.text: Construct restriction unit and composition isomorphisms sectionwise. Transpose the left-adjoint uniqueness maps and use the normalized unit on x↦1⊗x to prove the pure-tensor formulas. Compose the normalized derived transpose equations and apply uniqueness with the canonical exact restriction comparisons. Degreewise the ordinary uniqueness equation is the same unit equation; localization of that equation proves the derived cochain representative formulas.
